title: sandbox.snapshot — `runsc checkpoint [--leave-running]` of a sandbox (memory, processes and written files) into /var/lib/falak/sandboxes/snapshots/<snapshot_id> (root-only; it outlives the sandbox and keeps its base image from the image GC); idempotent by snapshot_id. With leave_running false the sandbox is stopped and removed after the checkpoint (as sandbox.kill). Errors: `sandbox <id> not found`. Feature sandbox.v2

id.description: the sandbox's id (lower-case ULID); runsc container falak-sbx-<id>

snapshot_id.description: the snapshot's id (lower-case ULID); stored under /var/lib/falak/sandboxes/snapshots/<snapshot_id>

leave_running.description: false: stop and remove the sandbox once checkpointed
